notes.title: Play Relooted's demo now!
notes.notes:
[p] [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3972400/Relooted_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Demo Trailer[/h3][previewyoutube="rYdHbhGYAAg;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
If you've been looking for heist action, now is the chance to scratch that itch. Kick off with some introductions to your crew members and learn why these artifacts should be returned. Next is figuring out the best way to overcome puzzles and utilise your crew and gadgets for your upcoming mission. 

Once you're briefed about the heist, it's time to put everything you've learned to the test! How quickly do you think you could escape?[/p][h3]

About the demo![/h3][p]This demo gives Players a taste of what [i]Relooted[/i] is like in roughly 30-60 minutes (more with replaying!)[/p][p]  
The structure of the demo is as so:[/p][list][*][p]Intro cinematic[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial level in VR[/p][/*][*][p]Hideout exploration[/p][list][*][p]Talk to the team[/p][/*][*][p]Read about previously collected artifacts[/p][/*][*][p]Get a briefing on your next heist[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Heist mission from early mid game (multiple ways to complete the heist)[/p][/*][*][p]Closing cinematic hinting at the game’s story[/p][/*][/list][p]  
The order of the cinematics and the level are custom for the demo to quickly let you experience the heist gameplay loop.

Have fun heisting![/p]
